title: GhostPay
tagline: Defi application that let you send and receive funds anonymously with just a link
description: GhostPay is a private payment dapp, allowing users to send and receive crypto privately, with just an URL instead of wallet address. Plus, users have the freedom to receive/claim crypto in any tokens they preferred. Alice can privately deposit an amount of ETH/ERC20 to the peanut contract from her railgun wallet address. This involves unshielding, unwrapping WETH, etc, in a batch call made possible with railgun's cross-contract call.
how_its_made:
GhostPay lets anyone privately send and receive crypto with the sharable URL link. Plus, users have the freedom to receive/claim crypto in any tokens they preferred. This is built at ETH Rome 2023. 

Railgun: An on-chain & smart contract-based system for private Ethereum/EVM DeFi.
Peanut Protocol: A protocol to transfer tokens using URLs
